title: Staff Order for Pointe Coupee Electric Membership Corporation and 1803 Electric Cooperative, Inc. — Order No. S-37960 accepts the Staff Report and Recommendation filed into the record on July 28, 2026, and the Commission expresses its non-opposition to Pointe Coupee Electric Membership Corporation (“PCE”) and 1803 Electric Cooperative Inc Joint Petiton for approval for PCE to become a full member of 1803, subject to the conditions within. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

Staff Review
            Staff reviewed the Petition, the direct testimony of Chief Operating Officer of 1803 Mr.

            Staff ¶V review included a review of the current structure of agreements that PC Electric has

agreements. PC (OHFWULF¶V contract with NEM for the NEMPSA would not change from any of

Joint Applicants provided a signed agreement from NEM indicating the assignment of PC Electric

contract to 1803.       Additionally, 1803 would be responsible for payments for power costs to NEM
and would then recover those costs from PC Electric through an existing 1803 wholesale rate tariff

as   they do from their other wholesale members.                   PC Electric has an agreement with SWPA for

Mondu PPA allowed PC Electric to receive Next Era grant funds that helped to offset costs for the

facility.    The Joint Applicants are seeking pre-approval of that assignment of this contract, but not

until such a time that RUS approves of it and that it will not impact the ability to receive the grant

funds. Until such an agreement is in place, PC Electric will keep the Mondu PPA in its own name

and would treat it in the same manner as the SWPA agreement.
